description: This file defines the ReadableProductPrice class, which represents product pricing details with original and final prices, and a discount indicator.

classes.name: ReadableProductPrice
classes.description: A Java class modeling product pricing details with properties for original price, final price, and discount status.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the original price of the product.

methods.name: setOriginalPrice
methods.description: Sets the original price of the product.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the final (sale) price of the product.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final (sale) price of the product.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Indicates whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Sets the discount status of the product.
